entry.title: The context problem nobody talks about: why AI coding agents waste 80% of tokens on files they already read yesterday
entry.summary: Every AI coding agent — Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI — starts every session completely blind. It doesn't know your projects. It doesn't know your servers. It doesn't remember that you spent three hours yesterday debugging the payment system. So it greps. It reads file after file. It SSHs into your server to check what's running. entry.title: How We Built Our Own DNS Server
entry.summary:
We wrote a production DNS server in ~1000 lines of Go, migrated thousands of records off Hetzner DNS, and dropped propagation time from "up to 90 minutes" to a few seconds. It uses the hidden primary pattern, Postgres as the event bus, and AXFR + IXFR to push zones to public secondaries. Here's how and why we did it!
Every service on Sliplane gets a managed subdomain like my-app-abc123.sliplane.app. That means an A and AAAA record for every running service, pointing at the server IP where the container lives. Records scale linearly with the platform. We started with Hetzner DNS because it was free and we already ran most of our infra there.
